expr.unclosed: This opens {call} and never closes it. Add a ).
expr.stops.add: The formula stops after {last}. Add the value it should add to.
expr.stops.subtract: The formula stops after {last}. Add the value it should subtract.
expr.stops.multiply: The formula stops after {last}. Add the value it should multiply by.
expr.stops.divide: The formula stops after {last}. Add the value it should divide by.
expr.stops.power: The formula stops after {last}. Add the power it should raise to.
expr.stops.default: The formula stops after {last}. Add the value that comes next.
expr.disabled.in: The in operator is not part of HUD formulas. A formula reads values and produces a number; it never sets anything, and it has no lists.
expr.disabled.assignment: Assignment is not part of HUD formulas. A formula reads values and produces a number; it never sets anything, and it has no lists.
expr.disabled.list: A list is not part of HUD formulas. A formula reads values and produces a number; it never sets anything, and it has no lists.
expr.empty: Nothing to read yet. Type a name, or pick one from the ƒ menu.
expr.too-long: A HUD formula is capped at {max} characters. This one is longer.
expr.and: This language writes "and" as and, not &&.
expr.or: || joins text here; it is not "or". It reads as two numbers written next to each other.
expr.adjacent: Two values with nothing between them.
expr.unknown-name: {name} is not a name this HUD knows.
starter.fraction: {stem} as a fraction of its maximum
starter.containers: how many containers a capacity is worth
starter.slice: this instance's slice of a total
starter.stagger: a stagger, in milliseconds per instance
starter.both: two things at once, joined by and instead of &&
catalog.scope.index: Which instance this is, from 0 to count−1.
catalog.scope.item: This instance's own value, from the repeat's item formula.
catalog.outside-repeat: Exists inside a repeat. This node is not in one.
catalog.not-a-transition: Exists on a transition's when. This field is not one.
catalog.delta: How much the bound value just changed by.
catalog.op.compare: Yields true/false, which reads back as 1/0. Every gate works this way.
catalog.op.and: Both. Never &&, which is a parse error.
catalog.op.or: Either. Never ||, which joins text and answers a wrong number.
catalog.op.if: A choice. Reads better than ? : once nested.
catalog.fn.ceil: Up to the next whole number.
catalog.fn.floor: Down to the whole number below.
catalog.fn.round-to: To a given number of decimal places.
catalog.fn.min: The smallest. min(max(x, lo), hi) is the clamp idiom.
catalog.fn.pow: a to the power b. Same as a ^ b.
catalog.const.pi: Reserved. A variable may not be called PI.
catalog.const.e: Reserved. A variable may not be called E.
catalog.const.bool: Reserved, and read back as 1 and 0.
refusal.source-locked: {dragged} is set in Content, not by dragging
refusal.target-locked: a repeat's child is set in Content
align.start: start puts children at the beginning of the axis
align.center: center puts children in the middle of the axis
align.end: end puts children at the end of the axis
align.stretch: stretch makes children fill their cell along this axis
align.between: between puts the free space between the children, none at the ends
align.around: around gives each child an equal share, half of it at each side
align.evenly: evenly makes every gap the same, the two at the ends included
extent.auto: auto (as big as what is in it)
extent.fill: fill (the rest of the main axis)
